instruction: I am going for a 15-minute drive without internet. Play an album from my Spotify library that already has enough downloaded songs for it, so I do not have to repeat.
notes: Single-app task (spotify) plus supervisor. Knowledge gathering: show_album_library reveals the library album ids (known-id), show_downloaded_songs reveals which songs are downloaded with their durations (downloads-known); the selection criterion 'album in library whose downloaded songs sum to >= 15 min' is encoded as the static facts (in-library target-album) and (downloads-sufficient target-album minutes-15) with the drive length as the discrete object minutes-15. play_music is called with album_id (optional API parameter the task uses); the duration parameter is a task record, not an API argument. The evaluation requires the final queue to contain all downloaded songs of the album and nothing outside the album, so the model requires clear_song_queue before play_music (harmless if play_music already replaces the queue, necessary if it appends); both calls only modify spotify.MusicPlayer, matching the expected changed models. The task asks no question, so complete_task carries no answer; its album parameter only ties the goal conditions (playing / queue-is-album) to the chosen album. Pagination of the library/download listings is abstracted into single lookup actions.
